A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] nicknamed "'''Slippery Hilts'''" lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] during [[Time of the Rot|the Time of the Rot]]. He [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Varner Hilts' mother|woman]] who gave [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] to a boy they named [[Varner Hilts|Varner]]. Varner Hilts' [[Parent/Legends|father]] was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] on Kesh, and sometime prior to [[3000 BBY]], he planned to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Unidentified faction leader|rival]]. However, the [[Sheath/Legends|sheath]] carrying Hilts' [[Shikkar|bladed weapon]] was poorly constructed, and the blade fell and lodged itself into his ankle. The Tribe then began to call him "Slippery Hilts," a nickname that stayed until he [[Death/Legends|died]] from an infection in his wound one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] later.

==Biography==
[[File:Shikkar.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A shikkar]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Hilts family]] was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] during [[Time of the Rot|the Time of the Rot]], a [[Time/Legends|period]] of turmoil and constant warring on the world. Hilts was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on Kesh&mdash;descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who had been stranded on the world after their [[Omen|starship]] [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|crashed]] there. Hilts [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Varner Hilts' mother|woman]], and in [[3060 BBY]] she gave [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] to their child, whom they named [[Varner Hilts|Varner]]. Varner Hilts' [[Parent/Legends|father]] worked for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to gain the trust of the [[Unidentified faction leader|leader]] of a [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Beray faction|faction]] of Sith in [[Beray]]. Sometime prior to [[3000 BBY]], he planned to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the head of the party and take the Sith's place.<ref name="Secrets" />

Hilts meticulously selected a [[shikkar]]<ref name="Secrets" />&mdash;a [[Glass/Legends|glass]] [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]] made for just one use, in which the blade was snapped off from the hilt, leaving it inside the victim's body<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>&mdash;to carry out his attack. However, he failed to properly build the [[Sheath/Legends|sheath]] in which he carried his shikkar, and before he could assassinate the faction leader, the blade fell and stabbed Hilts in the ankle. His fellow Tribe members found the accident a source of humor and began to call him "Slippery Hilts." Hilts' wound quickly became infected, and he [[Death/Legends|died]] within one [[Standard month/Legends|month]],<ref name="Secrets" /> under the age of sixty.<ref name="time" /> His widowed wife tried to seduce the leader just one [[Standard week/Legends|week]] later, but she also died in her attempt.<ref name="Secrets" />

==Personality and traits==
Slippery Hilts was a very ambitious man, as was the Hilts family as a whole. He also showed his patience by waiting years to gain the trust of his liege before attempting to stab the Sith and take control of the faction. Hilts was very particular in the selection of his shikkar, but his carelessness in crafting the sheath for the weapon ultimately resulted in his death.<ref name="Secrets" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Slippery Hilts" was first mentioned in the eighth [[eBook]] in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith|''Lost Tribe of the Sith'']] series, [[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Secrets|''Secrets'']], published in [[2012]].<ref name="Secrets" />
